description: The names of layered equipment's looks (core/equipment/mhgen/looks.py), in English, French, German, Italian and Spanish, copied once from MH Generations Ultimate's text by research/porting/xx_names.py --looks (XX has only Japanese text): `series` the five piece names (helm, body, arms, waist, legs) of the armor series with that index in XX's armorSeriesData, `weapons` the name of the weapon with that index in each class. The 14 series and 4 weapons MHGU names DUMMY have the names of MH Generations; the 18 series and 3 weapons that neither game names in Western text have names of ours, translated from XX's Japanese (looks_names_ours.json), not the game's. A record that is not here gives no look.
